raw_pages.raw_text:
C.R. Case No. 122 of 2021
       
11.07.2024
 
Complainant /Rasheed is present by filing Hazira.
All 04 accused persons/ Samsudeen, Afsa Guddu, Rafique and Aboobacker  
Chamma are present by filing Hazira.
At this stage, as scheduled, PW.1/ Rasheed / Complainant is examined in 
chief and thereafter declined to be cross examined before charge from the 
defence side and discharged.
At this stage, an adjournment petition is filed from the complainant side 
praying for adducing  further evidence.
The aforesaid prayer is duly perused, considered and stands allowed for the 
ends of Justice being formal in nature.
Complainant to ensure attendance of his concerned witness/es on the next 
scheduled date.
Fix 29.10.2024 for further evidence of Complainant side before charge and 
for passing further necessary orders.
Both complainant and accused persons  to remain present.
         
  
    Dictated and corrected by me
             
   
  Judicial Magistrate 
                            Judicial Magistrate 
            
     (Addl. Court),                                                                  (Addl. Court),
                
         Port Blair.
                                               Port Blair.
